data.headline: Thirty-year yield holds as the long-end spread narrows
data.summary: The thirty-year Treasury yield held at 5.26% from November 6 to 9. The ten-year yield rose to 4.88%, narrowing the thirty-year minus ten-year spread to 38 basis points.

bull.text: The asset-manager net long in Treasury bond futures rose from 383,981 to 415,379 contracts between October 27 and November 3.

bear.text: The leveraged-fund net short in Treasury bond futures increased from 150,393 to 166,257 contracts between October 27 and November 3.

watch.text: The thirty-year yield held at 5.26% while the ten-year yield rose from 4.86% to 4.88%. Their spread narrowed from 40 to 38 basis points. These are benchmark yields. TLT’s portfolio exposures and returns require separate evidence.

limitations: The Treasury observations in this report are dated November 9. No verified ETF closing price or return is available.
The CFTC observations are weekly futures positions as of November 3. ETF flows and investor intent require separate evidence.
